pages.title: Equip for the fight
pages.text: The Energy Sabre is a strong melee weapon. The Enhanced Energy Sabre adds module controls. With ArienteWorld, soldiers rarely drop their carried weapons; look for blueprints and Storage Cube loot to equip yourself.$(br2)Hold the enhanced sabre in your main hand and use the armor configuration key to install and enable modules. Their power comes from the same carried $(l:ariente:equipment/fuel)Energy Holder$(/l) as your armor. Refill through the holder’s own panel or enable its Automatic collection mode.

pages.title: Sabre upgrades
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Power$(): doubles the weapon’s damage bonus; usage 30.$(li)$(item)Inhibit$(): strips beneficial effects and suppresses Master Soldier regeneration for 10 seconds; usage 30.$(li)$(item)Looting$(): grants Looting III; usage 20.$(li)$(item)Fire$(): grants Fire Aspect III; usage 30.$(br2)Energy Efficiency also fits: it raises this weapon’s module budget and reduces its fuel draw.$(br2)Sabres still use durability. Check it as well as the shared holder’s fuel.

pages.title: Constructing the upgrade
pages.text: Use the matching Enhanced Energy Sabre blueprint in a Constructor or Auto Constructor. The blueprint is reusable.$(br2)Materials: Energy Sabre, Circuit, 3 Silicon, 5 Negarite Dust, 5 Posirite Dust, 3 Platinum Ingots and 2 Lithium Ingots.

pages.title: Ranged upgrades
pages.text: The Energy Lance supports the same five weapon modules as the Enhanced Energy Sabre. Hold it in your main hand, leave the off hand empty, and press $(thing)0$() to configure it.$(br2)Power, Inhibit, Looting and Fire affect its lasers. Energy Efficiency raises its module budget and reduces its draw on the shared Energy Holder.$(br2)See the Energy Lance entry for firing and blueprint details.
